# `communique publish`

- **Usage:** `communique publish [--dry-run] <DRAFT>`
- **Effect:** modifies state

Publish an edited JSON draft without invoking an LLM

## Arguments
- **`<DRAFT>`** — JSON artifact written by generate --draft

## Flags
- **`--dry-run`** — Preview the final release body without writing to GitHub
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
